episodes.title: L'âme Perdue
episodes.summary: Following his departure from The Commonwealth, Daryl Dixon washes ashore in France, raising the ire of a splintered but growing autocratic movement centered in Paris and endangering a young boy at the heart of a benevolent religious movement.

episodes.title: Alouette
episodes.summary: Daryl, Isabelle, Laurent and Sylvie face trouble on the road; Isabelle remembers the day the hungry ones appeared; Laurent struggles to fit in.

episodes.title: Paris Sera Toujours Paris
episodes.summary: The group's arrival in Paris brings help from old friends and attention from new foes.

episodes.title: La Dame de Fer
episodes.summary: Daryl and Isabelle negotiate with the owner of the Demimonde club.

episodes.title: Deux Amours
episodes.summary: Daryl and Laurent travel to the Nest as Isabelle considers her options. Genet enacts her plan.

episodes.title: Coming Home
episodes.summary: Genet solidifies her base of power; Daryl has a job to do before he can return to America.

episodes.title: La Gentillesse Des Étrangers
episodes.summary: Carol Peletier and Daryl Dixon confront old demons in their fight to reunite with each other halfway around the world and protect the people they love.

episodes.title: Moulin Rouge
episodes.summary: Carol and Ash take an unexpected detour; Daryl and Isabelle uncover a new threat at the Nest.

episodes.title: L'Invisible
episodes.summary: Carol hunts for information; Daryl and Isabelle race to save one of their own; Pouvoir regroups.

episodes.title: Le Paradis Pour Toi
episodes.summary: All hope is lost amidst Genet's attack on the Nest.

episodes.title: Vouloir, C'est Pouvoir
episodes.summary: A new faction of survivors hunt down Laurent; Carol's lies come to a head.

episodes.title: Au Revoir Les Enfants
episodes.summary: An exit strategy is charted from France.

episodes.title: Costa Da Morte
episodes.summary: A chance encounter provides a potential way home; Daryl makes a tough decision.

episodes.title: La Ofrenda
episodes.summary: Shipwrecked in Spain, Daryl and Carol seek refuge in a peaceful village.

episodes.title: El Sacrificio
episodes.summary: Daryl focuses on getting home while Carol gets more invested in Solaz.

episodes.title: La Justicia Fronteriza
episodes.summary: Daryl and Carol disagree on how to move forward; a surprise attack changes everything.

episodes.title: Limbo
episodes.summary: Carol helps Antonio and Roberto while Daryl journeys into the desert in search of someone.

episodes.title: Contrabando
episodes.summary: Daryl and Paz in Barcelona. Carol and Antonio face the fallout of Solaz.

episodes.title: Solaz Del Mar
episodes.summary: Our heroes fight to protect the people they love.
